card.name: Linking words before barrier contraception examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words (such as, a, or, and) right before or between barrier birth-control examples like condom, spermicide and diaphragm, in back-up contraception instructions.

modes.label: After "such"
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" just before a list of barrier methods.
modes.example: non-hormonal back-up contraception (such<< as>> condoms and spermicide, or diaphrag

modes.label: Before condom
modes.description: The word "a" after "such as" and before condom.
modes.example: use a back-up method of birth control, such as<< a>> condom or sperm

modes.label: Between barrier items
modes.description: "or" or "and" joining condom, spermicide or diaphragm in a list.
modes.example: such as a condom<< or>> sperm

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words for barrier methods such as condom, spermicide and diaphragm, with some link to friction and sling words.
card.plain: It fires on the little words that lead into condom, spermicide or diaphragm when a label lists back-up birth control.
